title: Spares Capture Part Record
description: Canonical output record for marine spare-parts extraction.

part_no.description: Manufacturer part number, order number, ident number, code number, or equivalent.

qty.description: Quantity as written in the source document.

unit.description: Unit of measure, such as Pcs, Set, or PCS.

drawing_ref.description: Drawing number, reference number, table number, or figure reference.

component.description: Top-level component name from the extraction profile.

sub_component.description: Subcomponent, table title, assembly, group, or page-level section.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name from the extraction profile or detected source metadata.

model.description: Equipment model, engine model, pump model, or source-specific model text.
